concerns.text: Task T002 generates a deterministic synthetic dataset as a fallback and is tagged as satisfying FR‑001. FR‑001 explicitly requires ingestion of *experimental* diffusion data; allowing synthetic data to fulfill the requirement weakens the functional requirement.

Task T012 only writes evaluation.json when real data is present and exits silently for synthetic data. This conditional skipping means SC‑001 (Pearson r measurement) and SC‑002 (RMSE comparison) are not exercised when only synthetic data is available, effectively weakening the success criteria that must be measured.
No task records total pipeline runtime, yet SC‑003 requires measuring total runtime against the CI runner time limit. The absence of any runtime logging or reporting violates the success criterion.
No task records peak memory usage, yet SC‑005 mandates measuring memory usage against the RAM constraint. The missing memory profiling step constitutes a violation of the success criterion.

Task T014 adds a learning‑rate sweep to the hyperparameter sweep, which is not mentioned in the spec or plan. While not a weakening of any requirement, it introduces unstated scope and should be either documented in the plan or removed to keep the task list aligned with the specification.
